acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every `Microsoft.Extensions.*` `<PackageReference>` in both csprojs has a `Version` whose major component is `10`.
`Serilog.Extensions.Hosting` references in both projects are at the highest stable version available compatible with .NET 10, and the two references resolve to the same version.
For any package name appearing in both csprojs, the `Version` attribute is byte-identical across both files.
`dotnet restore` and `dotnet build` of the solution complete with zero warnings and zero errors.
No framework-agnostic package (Dapper, MySqlConnector, SharpCompress, Serilog.Sinks.*, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm, Avalonia*) receives a major-version jump in this WP.
